summary_1line: Sanat-sujata explains true asceticism, self-restraint, renunciation, and knowledge as the path to Brahman, rejecting mere Vedic learning without virtue.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sanat-sujata sits calmly before the blind king Dhritarashtra in a dim royal chamber, teaching about the silent and formless Supreme Soul.
Vedas portrayed as young birds flying away from a deceitful man who clutches sacred texts but lacks self-control.
A solitary ascetic renounces worldly pleasures, standing serene while symbols of wealth, praise, and desire fade behind him.
